verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a cloud platform with a CLI, SDKs and CDK tooling, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any control to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The 'aws history' commands cover local command history, which is a different feature and does not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
